mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, status_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{statusId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.name as authorName, u.company_name as authorCompany, u.role as authorRole FROM post p JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.is_deleted = false
